scientific_integrity: General energy descent attributed to prior work; explicit exact enumerator and classification are separately proved. Exhaustive checks n=3..9 are supporting evidence only, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats n>=3 simple circular prisms with uniform random one-site, closed-neighborhood minority and tie retention. It does not give basin probabilities or exact expected absorption times; 6n^2 is an upper bound. Some specialized enumeration literature might remain unindexed; no independent validation has occurred.
title: Exact metastable-energy census for asynchronous minority dynamics on circular prisms
